root_cause: The merchant's gateway is configured with an incorrect MCC, causing transactions to be processed under a higher-cost category instead of the registered B2B wholesale code 5045.
diagnosis: 51 transactions totaling Rs 9,444.31 were charged at elevated interchange rates because the gateway applied a non-5045 MCC, triggering interchange downgrades. Note: This analysis uses a modeled benchmark as the source status is 'illustrative'.
action_rationale: Updating the gateway configuration to the correct registered MCC 5045 will align transaction processing with the merchant's actual business type, eliminating the structural fee leak.
